texts.486d43f355b1: The study has two main aims i) to determine whether a low dose of radioactive iodine is as effective as the commonly used high (3.7GBq) in ablating any remaining thyroid tissue after surgery. ii) to determine whether taking recombinant human Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (rhTSH) has no adverse effect on radioactive ablation of the thyroid remnant compared to the current practice of withdrawing thyroid hormone
